Its subject is not the adventure but the BOND at the centre of it: a mother and her most troublesome child, holding on to each other while the world splits in half behind them. Built on a JOURNEY OF LIGHT — golden warmth on one side, storm darkness on the other, and the two of them together on the line between. Painterly-photoreal rendering, rich cinematic depth, layered composition, 8K poster finish. Landscape one-sheet framing.

THE EMOTIONAL CORE — dead centre, large, the poster's whole reason: <<<5acf4096-02e3-4006-ab1e-b27aafcc9151>>> and <<<a268e94c-5ab8-416d-82b3-6f1ea6bd7822>>> TOGETHER as one entwined silhouette. A single winding RIVER runs through the poster behind them, and it stays a river at every point — a defined channel with two visible banks, riverside trees on both sides, water contained between them.
